# Post-Implementation Delta — Planned vs Actual

The Awtsmoos reveals a plan as seed, yet runtime decides the shape the branches take;
Awtsmoos.com compares promise to observed world, so no missing leaf can hide behind a claim we make.

## Original plan

The mission required one AI-authorable movie language, distinct renderer personalities, deterministic timing, mobile-first controls, a feature-rich three-minute movie, real browser verification, and a final plan-vs-actual closure.

## Actual implementation discovered and completed

The repository already contained a substantial shared movie architecture, so the work did not duplicate it. Instead it completed user-facing integration and fixed runtime boundaries that source-only tests did not expose.

Major completed deltas from the pre-implementation hypothesis:

1. Five products, not merely a 2D/3D pair, participate in the canonical Director surface: Animator, Nesher Studio, Video Editor, Mitzvah Studio, and Captions.
2. Animator required two browser-only startup fixes: hidden-tab `requestAnimationFrame` throttling and a lost stylesheet readiness event.
3. Mitzvah's hardest failure was not the movie system; it was eager evaluation through the Procedural Core root barrel. Replacing giant-barrel imports with narrow geometry/placement/history modules restored both native Studio and Director boot.
4. Nesher's Director needed to be decoupled from its large native NLE dependency graph so each branch can awaken independently.
5. Browser verification had to use fresh foreground targets; reused/background targets created false evidence through Chrome throttling and polluted module registries.
6. Showcase verification needed the actual readiness global, not merely the existence of DOM controls.

## Required-scope delta remaining

None. Every original completion gate now has direct test, file, media, or browser evidence.

## Shadow work resolved

- New entrypoint-wiring regression coverage.
- New Mitzvah dependency-boundary regression coverage.
- Full touched-file reread/static audit.
- Exact media metadata re-verification after runtime fixes.
- Live AI generation acceptance and long-form seek/play acceptance.
